name: smart-garage
description: Smart Garage — self-hosted vehicle management for Unraid. Maintenance, fuel analytics, expenses, documents, and reminders. One container, SQLite database, automatic updates via :latest image.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: SQLite database and uploads. Created automatically by Unraid.

variables.name: Fuel prices: Tankerkönig API key
variables.description: Optional. Enables the live fuel price page (German filling stations). Request a free key at https://onboarding.tankerkoenig.de/ — registrations are reviewed by hand, so the key arrives by email after a few days, up to about a week. You can paste it here, or enter it later under Settings -> Fuel prices in the app (no container restart needed). Left empty, the Fuel prices page just explains how to get a key. Guide: https://github.com/flizzy27/smart-garage/blob/main/docs/FUEL-PRICES.md

variables.name: SSO: issuer URL
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. Base URL of your OpenID Connect provider, e.g. https://id.example.com (Pocket ID, Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia). Leave empty to keep username/password login only. Guide: https://github.com/flizzy27/smart-garage/blob/main/docs/OIDC.md

variables.name: SSO: client ID
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. Client ID registered with your provider.

variables.name: SSO: client secret
variables.description: Optional single sign-on. Client secret registered with your provider.

variables.name: SSO: button label
variables.description: Optional. Text on the login button, e.g. 'Pocket ID'. Defaults to 'Single Sign-On'.

variables.name: SSO: redirect URI
variables.description: Optional. Only needed behind a reverse proxy that does not forward X-Forwarded-Proto/Host. Example: https://garage.example.com/api/auth/oidc/callback

variables.name: SSO: allow account creation
variables.description: Optional. 'false' only lets people sign in who already have an account here. Default is 'true'.
